description: FamilySearch record collections for Hill/Smith County, Texas (marriage, probate). The Texas County Marriage Records entry was reassigned mock collection id 1416518 (from 1417683) to resolve a cross-fixture collision: 1417683 is the 1880 US Census everywhere else it appears (collections-search-us-national.json and two record-search-*-1880 fixtures), so this marriage collection reusing that id contradicted them on title and all three counts (issue #2484 PR2). Its three counts are self-consistent for a marriage collection (personCount 9,640,000 ~= 2x recordCount 4,820,000). The point is a self-consistent mock world, not a live-verified id.
